name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.permission.QChatChannelPermissionActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from channel settings to show the members and roles with channel access. Users can add or remove them and open their channel permission settings.
disableEffect: Users cannot manage member and role access to a QChat channel through the built-in permission screen.
